name: wpscan
description: WPScan WordPress security scanner. Written for security professionals and blog maintainers to test the security of their WordPress websites. Contact us via contact@wpscan.com

latest_release.name: v4.2.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed

### Added
* `--max-response-size MiB` caps how much of any response is read (default 16 MiB, `0` disables), guarding against memory exhaustion on targets serving huge or endless responses by @gnuletik in https://github.com/wpscanteam/wpscan/pull/2091

### Changed
* Responses larger than 16 MiB are now truncated by default. Use `--max-response-size 0` to restore the previous unbounded behavior. by @gnuletik in https://github.com/wpscanteam/wpscan/pull/2091
* SARIF now reports aborted runs as unsuccessful, with the abort reason in `toolExecutionNotifications`. Consumers will show an aborted scan as a failed analysis instead of a clean run with zero alerts. The CLI exit code is unchanged. by @derekxmartin in https://github.com/wpscanteam/wpscan/pull/2094

### Fixed
* Scan no longer aborts with "long too big to dump" when a response is too large to cache by @gnuletik in https://github.com/wpscanteam/wpscan/pull/2090
* JSON output no longer crashes when the WP JSON API returns users without a slug by @gnuletik in https://github.com/wpscanteam/wpscan/pull/2093
* SARIF includes parent-theme advisories by @derekxmartin in https://github.com/wpscanteam/wpscan/pull/2095

### Maintenance
* Docker image now built on `ruby:4.0.9-alpine` (Alpine 3.24), and Dependabot tracks the base image by @Initsogar in https://github.com/wpscanteam/wpscan/pull/2101
* CLI integration tests also run with a free API token by @ArSn in https://github.com/wpscanteam/wpscan/pull/2081
* Dependency bumps: rubocop, simplecov, webmock

## New Contributors
* @gnuletik made their first contribution in https://github.com/wpscanteam/wpscan/pull/2093
* @derekxmartin made their first contribution in https://github.com/wpscanteam/wpscan/pull/2094

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/wpscanteam/wpscan/compare/v4.1.0...v4.2.0
